Parking: This property provides two driveway parking spots, offering guests direct access to the unit.

Experience Your Vacation Haven
Contemporary accents unite with an urban feel to deliver the home for your beach vacation! When you’re joining two families or a large group together for a memorable vacation items on your list of “must haves” are usually: space, privacy and comfort. Well, go ahead and move to the next items on your list because we’ve got these covered.

Space – Check! Unique to this vacation home are its two living spaces. The first floor and second floor each boast their own living space complete with Smart TVs and DVD players.

Privacy – Check! Each of the three bedrooms and the bunk room include en suite bathrooms for the ultimate in privacy. There is an additional powder bath on the first floor for added privacy.

Comfort – double check! The property offers a master suite on the first floor and a second on the second floor for added comfort. Not to mention the truly vibrant, high-end furnishings filling the spacious, open floor plan to accommodate everyone in your group day or night.

Believe it or not there is more. The kitchen, living room and dining room each flow together allowing the fun and conversation to never end. Pull up a chair at the breakfast bar for a quick snack before heading out or fill the beautiful Quartzite countertops with that seafood buffet dinner you have been mentally planning for months. The home’s patio offers beautiful views of the Baytowne Golf Course. The full dining set will welcome coffee lovers to a nice start to their day.

About the Community of Villa Lago
Villa Lago is the latest addition to the SANDESTIN GOLF AND BEACH RESORT® offering single family 3-, 4- and 5-bedroom homes with Mediterranean-style and resort comforts. Enjoy amenities such as the community pool and the first class dining and entertainment options of the Village of Baytowne Wharf. Most properties have either a lake or golf course view. Rent with us today and discover what a truly relaxing and carefree vacation feels like at Villa Lago. Amenities such as golf, tennis, biking, boating, water sports & more are available locally at additional costs.

Local Favorites
MVH guests receive savings with our Local Favorites. Enjoy discounts to restaurants, beach activities, and shopping so you can save while you stay.
